summary: Catalogue-wide link screen for 212 atlas roadmaps and six additional blueprint definitions, independently reviewed at 6fb1abbb64e76b1c65de3ccbb36d91ef2af7b377. Retains one character-carrier input, 24 analytic outputs and seven ownership overlaps. The powered-Frobenius coefficient and higher-power comparison are already present at the pinned Tau Ceti baseline; reuse them while preserving the missing analytic-boundary obligations. Complete describes the link screen, not mathematical implementation.

screen.readDepth: All summaries and catalogue-wide title/description/document synonym search; every plausible endpoint stage read in full. Negative entries are not claims that every mathematical proof or every full document was read.
